response.answer_tenant: Your landlord can't raise your rent more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, over any 12-month period.
response.answer_owner: You may not raise the gross rental rate more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, in 12 months.
